summary: Round-1 verdict was already approved; round-2 re-checks the outage_state + admin-ping addition introduced in commit fd6f1ed. The new code path adds two new IO operations: (1) `outage_state.record_outage_event(datetime.now(timezone.utc))` which writes to bot_state SQLite (parameterized SQL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, no user input — safe); (2) `send_admin_notification(ping_text)` where ping_text comes from outage_state's _PING_1_TEXT / _PING_2_TEXT / _PING_3_TEXT module constants (Russian fixed strings, zero user-controllable surface). Both new IOs preserve the secret-redaction guarantees: send_admin_notification routes through _redact_text, record_outage_event uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) which has no secret content. The outer state_err except branch logs via sanitize_error_message — covered by _SECRET_ENV_NAMES which includes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
